[[File:Game-Of-Crone-Logo.png|alt=White gothic text that reads 'Game of Crone'|thumb|500x500px|Game of Crone Logo]]

==Description==
You’ll have to help the escaped prisoners of the Inquisition survive in the wilderness by providing them with everything they need. To develop their camp to a fortified settlement while keeping in mind its benefits. To protect those who entrusted you with their lives, from the sword and fire. And also - to untangle the circumstances of the cruel game, which turned into the Great Blast and the return of the Ancient Curse.<ref name=":Steam DLC Store Page">https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430990/Graveyard_Keeper__Game_Of_Crone/</ref>

===What to Expect===
*Develop the prisoners’ [[refugee camp]] into a fortified settlement.
*Protect the camp by sword and fire.
*Untangle the secrets of the Great Blast and the return of the Ancient Curse.
*Enjoy brand new [[Universal bag|bag]] mechanics.
*Get access to [[Cook|new dishes]], [[The Graveyard|gravestones]], [[The Graveyard|fences]], [[Graves]] and to [[Scroll of Teleportation|teleportation scrolls.]]
*Deal with a vampire terrorizing a peaceful Village. 
*Unravel the secret of the mysterious death of your predecessor.
*Find out even more terrible secrets of your old and new friends.
*Become an ally of [[Donkey|Comrade Donkey]] and take part in the [[Revolutionary message|Revolution!]]<ref name=":Steam News Post1">https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/599140/view/2967269148126582701</ref>

===Other Info===
*You can finish the DLC both from the beginning and after the whole game.
*If you have already finished the game, this DLC will take from 3 to 10 extra hours to complete, depending on your level of progress.
*New achievements!
*The price is the same as the previous DLC. ''As of May 2024: $10 USD on all platforms; subject to regional pricing.''
*New music appears in the DLC, and is included in the Graveyard Keeper OST.<ref name=":Steam News Post1">https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/599140/view/2967269148126582701</ref><ref name=":Steam Store OST page">https://store.steampowered.com/app/919050/Graveyard_Keeper_OST/?curator_clanid=27930497</ref>

==Releases==
Game of Crone released on October 27th 2020, for Windows, macOS X, and Ubuntu;<ref name=":Steam News Post1">https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/599140/view/2967269148126582701</ref> on November 6th 2020, developer Lazy Bear Games confirmed that it was being ported to consoles;<ref name=":Dev Port Tweet">https://x.com/LazyBearGames/status/1324730114907713538</ref> on June 23rd 2021, it was released for PlayStation 4, Xbox One & Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch.<ref name=":Publisher Console Release Trailer">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C70ilwmFqVQ</ref>

==Notes==
*This DLC contains three different endings. Despite all of them being cliff-hangers, there are perks that come with them. If you want to see all of them, you should save and back up your game '''''before''''' you build the watchtower at the [[Refugee camp|Refugee Camp]].
